summary.text: Sam Garrison represents District 11 in the Florida House of Representatives, elected in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Garrison is an attorney from Fleming Island who served as an Assistant State Attorney in the 4th Judicial Circuit from 2001 to 2011 and chaired the St. Johns River State College Board of Trustees in 2018-2020.
Garrison was born in Peoria, Illinois, and holds degrees from Samford University and the University of Illinois College of Law.
